name: Japanese Miso Cod with Rice and Greens

components.name: Miso Cod
steps: Two to three DAYS before cooking, mix white miso, mirin, sake and sugar; coat cod in marinade and refrigerate sealed. This advance requirement is part of the source recipe.
On cooking day, scrape off excess miso completely to prevent the sugar from burning. Preheat oven to 200 C.
Place fish skin-side up on a lined tray and bake about 18-22 minutes until thickest centre reaches 63 C.

Pack fish separately from rice and greens. Do not treat uncooked marinade as cooked sauce; nutrition calculations count marinade ingredients even though much is discarded, so macros need kitchen verification.

components.name: Japanese Rice
steps: Rinse rice and cook in measured water, then rest covered 10 minutes.

components.name: Bok Choy Greens

ingredients.name: Raw baby bok choy or spinach

steps: Quickly steam or sauté greens and season with sesame oil and soy sauce.

Freezer: BETTER FREEZE RAW MARINATED fish before cooking where appropriate; cooked cod less freezer-friendly
Dietary: Contains fish, soy and cooking ALCOHOL (sake/mirin); NOT halal-friendly as written.

Refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers at 4°C or colder, for 3–4 days at most, and follow the shorter seafood limit above. Cook fish and shellfish to 63°C and reheat leftovers to at least 74°C.

preservationAndReheating: Refrigerate cooked food promptly in shallow covered containers. Target within 2 hours, or 1 hour when ambient temperature exceeds 32 C.
Refrigerate at 4 C or below for 3-4 days maximum; freeze later-week portions soon after cooking.
Reheat cooked leftovers to 74 C. Cook fish and crustaceans to 63 C (145 F) or applicable local food-safety standard. Use a food thermometer.
When a recipe includes rice, cool it rapidly and store cold immediately; avoid leaving cooked rice at room temperature.
Freeze in suitable airtight food-safe containers. Defrost in refrigerator, not on counter. Reheat crisp foods in oven when possible.
